question: Do caption-assignment benefits and source-retrieval costs replicate under a nonlinear bottleneck adaptation family?

training.architecture: Independent image and text bias-free dim->128->dim residual branches. First projection seeded PyTorch Linear initialization, final projection zero. Output L2 normalized. 262144 learned parameters for dim512.
training.choice_rationale: ReLU creates input-dependent gates even for small normalized-feature preactivations. This changes both capacity and functional class relative to the original linear adapter.
training.base_hyperparameters: Inherit unchanged original learning rates,seeds,batches,AdamW,weight decay,gradient clipping,10 epochs,and frozen logit scale. Batch-order RNG is paired across policies.
training.data: Same original1200 training images and all own source and hypothesis candidates. Existing cached features; fixed original score-stratified assignments reused verbatim.
training.checkpoint_retention: Record all11 epoch metrics,development predictions,and serialized checkpoint digests. Retain only best(native),best(source retrieval),and epoch10 weights per fit. Others deterministically regenerable.

selection.native: Unchanged100-image original development source-or-supported retrieval and relation criterion.
selection.source_retrieval: Mean image-to-text and text-to-image R1 on full dev900/4500 source-caption pool.
selection.learning_rate: Best mean selected score across seeds per policy/draw;lower rate ties.
selection.draws: Each random draw selected separately;all3 averaged,no best-draw selection.
selection.held_out_use: None. All choices fixed before running this replication.

evaluation.states: Frozen reference,all45 epoch10 states,and unique nonzero states selected by both development criteria.
evaluation.numerics: Original evaluator:float32 forward normalization,float64 similarities,stable manifest-index rank ties,relation half-credit,strict triplet comparisons.
evaluation.provenance: Bind protocol,code,inputs,assignments,checkpoints,and selected states before scoring. Save raw per-query ranks or item correctness/scores.

primary_analysis.aggregation: Average all3 score draws within optimizer seed,then average3 seeds within image. Cluster all5text queries by owningimage.
primary_analysis.intervals: Two-sided paired image-cluster percentile bootstrap with Bonferroni family12;conditional on fitted seeds,draws,and gallery.
primary_analysis.secondary: All other datasets,selected strategies,rank cutoffs,and cross-architecture comparisons descriptive;report allcells.

relationship_to_existing_results: New post-review replication informed by completed linear results. Original study unchanged. This changes adaptation family,not pretrained encoder or training corpus.
